notes.title: Minor feature updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The battlefield no longer requires all combatants to participate, except for the protagonist and necessary personnel in the plot. Players can now choose their own participants, and the maximum number of participants is still 12. (It is recommended that players use this feature when they have a full understanding of the game plot and want to challenge high difficulty or demonstrate their superior gaming skills.)
[*] Slightly optimize UI details
[*] The version number corresponds to 1.0.4
[/list]

notes.title: Game optimization
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the Fishman exit button in the upper right corner disappeared after the player controlled the character to move in battle. Although it was not a fatal bug, it affected the game's appearance. Therefore, the exit button has been made visible correctly
[*] Adjust the upgrade curve of one's own character, currently focusing entirely on the main attributes, to better fit the character's own characteristics
[*] Slightly lowered, the normal attack calculation formula for some characters on our side has been reduced, making them less supermodels. The average drop is around 20%
[*] Refined the prompts for combat standby and combat defense, making them easier to understand
[/list]

notes.title: Fine tuning of combat unit attributes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adjust the spell attack value of enemy legal units to make the noble mage no longer appear weak and powerless, although they are still fragile.
[*] Additional description: The corresponding version 1.0.3 of the game has added a battle auto save function, which will now automatically save the last two turn records controlled by the player.
[*] This version number will only be changed when new features are added.
[/list]
